l.a:
The teacher models how to introduce her/himself and to say where you live. Eg: My name is teacher Jacky, I live in Kacyiru.
Pupils repeat after the teacher.
Pupils practice with the teacher. On the circle, the teacher points to one pupil to introduces him/herself and says where she/he lives. They take turns, until each of them gets a chance to practice.

l.t: Describing Places in Our Village
l.o: Identify and name common places in their village and describe the location of places using prepositions of place
l.c: School, church, playground, home, road, map, village, next to, opposite, near, behind, in front of, left, right, straight ahead
l.a:
Teachers use pictures to introduce places in a village using pictures from the pupil book. Eg: church, market, school, etc. Pupils repeat after her.
Practice in small groups: Pupils look at a village map in the pupil book and identify key places. They take turns to name them (eg: school, church, playground, etc.).
The teacher uses real objects to demonstrate places using prepositions of place. Eg: Use a box and a chalk and place a chalk in different places vs the box. Eg: The chalk is in the box. The chalk is on the box, the chalk is under the box, etc… Pupils repeat after the teacher.
Practice in pairs or small groups:
Pupils go back to the village map in the pupil book and work together to locate buildings. Eg: The church is next to the mosque.
Pupils work together to complete sentence starters orally: “My name is… I live in… Our village has a big market. The market is next to the ..., etc.”
l.m: Pictures, real objects, pupil book
l.e: Teacher checks for accuracy in pronunciation and key vocabulary use
l.r: English Pupil’s book, Primary 3. (2026).

l.t: Phonics - Practice /au/
l.o:
Read a decodable text with words containing -au patterns;
Talk and write about the decodable text
l.c: Practice words: aunt, astronaut, launch, sauce Sight words: everywhere, tired, sorry and laughs; Decodable text: Paul’s drawing
l.a:
With picture support, pupils write the missing -au- sound to make the word. Then read the words. (e.g. ___nt → aunt; astron__t → astronaut; l____nch → launch; s____ce → sauce);
Teacher guides pupils to read the weekly decodable text and to talk and write about it: Before reading: Pupils read and copy sight words (everywhere, tired, sorry, laughs). The teacher shows the picture and reads the title with pupils. Pupils make predictions based on the title and the pictures.
During reading: Pupils whisper read the decodable text: Paul’s drawing. The teacher models how to read as pupils follow along tracing with fingers. Pupils choral-read louder with the teacher. Pupils read one by one, in pairs, bench by bench, row by row, etc.
Pupils circle the sight words from above and underline the -au- words.
After reading: Check pupils’ predictions. Ask comprehension questions and guide pupils to know how and where they can find the answers in the story. (e.g: Why does Paul take his pencil everywhere? What does Paul want to draw? What is Paul’s sister eating? Why did Paul laugh?).
l.m: Picture cards, flashcards, workbook/ decodable text
l.e: Teacher monitors and notes accuracy in reading and spelling.

l.t: Phonics - Review /aw/, /au/, /all/ and /alk/
l.o: Read decodable text with words containing -aw, -au, -all,- and -alk patterns; Talk and write about the decodable text
l.c: Review words: chalk, talk, yawn, tall, launch Sight words: against and cry; Decodable text: Paul and the ball
l.a:
With picture support, pupils read the word and match the word to the picture. (e.g. tall, chalk, talk, yawn, launch);
Teacher guides pupils to read the weekly decodable text and to talk and write about it:
Before reading: Pupils read and copy sight words (against, cry). The teacher shows the picture and reads the title with pupils. Pupils make predictions based on the title and the pictures.
During reading: Pupils whisper read the decodable text: Paul and the ball. The teacher models how to read as pupils follow along tracing with fingers. Pupils choral-read louder with the teacher. Pupils read one by one, in pairs, bench by bench, row by row, etc.
Pupils circle the sight words from above and underline the -aw- and -all- words.
After reading: Check pupils’ predictions. Ask comprehension questions and guide pupils to know how and where they can find the answers in the story. (e.g: Who likes to play ball all day? What happens when Paul kicks the ball against the wall? Why does the baby start to cry? What does a mother do when the baby starts to cry?)

l.t: End of unit assessment
l.o: Consolidate learning from week 6, week 7, week 8 and week 9
l.c: See key words from week 6, week 7, week 8 and week 9
l.a:
Oral quiz: In pairs pupils say what we find in the market, talk about buying and selling, ask for amounts and roleplay buying and selling things.
Reading exercise: Pupils read words or short sentences with targeted sounds from week 6, week 7, week 8 and week 9. Eg: yawn, draw, laundry, launch, hall, stalk, call, chalk.
Written exercise: Pupils complete the following activities:
● Matching things with market and their prices;
● Matching pictures and words with targeted sounds and reading the words. (e.g., “wall,” “sauce”, “saw”)
● Filling in missing letters in phonics words and reading the words made. (e.g. astron _t → astronaut, dr__ →draw, w__→walk, f__ →fall). ● Dictation of decodable words with sounds previously learned. Eg: aunt, applause, straw, talk, tall.
l.m: Workbook
l.e: Teacher checks sentence accuracy, pronunciation, spelling, and sound-letter matching, marking oral responses
l.r: P3 Pupil Book Workbook Term 3

u.k: Pupils listen attentively and communicate about shopping; read and write words with target sounds; read decodable texts accurately; and answer comprehension questions correctly.

•Gushaka andi magambo arimo igihekane no kuyandika.
l.m:
•Imfashanyigisho zifatika n'zidafatika;
•Amashusho yo mu gitabo cy’umwarimu gikubiyemo inkuru zisomerwa abanyeshuri.

l.t: Gusoma agakuru karimo igihekane vy/Vy na ryw/Ryw
l.o: •Gusoma agakuru no gusubiza ibibazo byabajijweho;
l.c: •Iby'ingenzi bikubiye mu gakuru umunyesh uri yisomeye n'inyungur amagambo.
l.m:
•Imfashanyigisho zifatika n'zidafatik;
•Amashusho yo mu gitabo cy’umwarimu gikubiyemo inkuru zisomerwa abanyeshuri.
l.e: •Gusaba abanyeshuri gusoma agakuru, gusubiza ibibazo byabajijweho no gukoresha amagambo yasobanuwe mu nteruro.

l.t: Isuzuma risoza icyumweru n'imyitozo nzamurab ushobozi na nyagurabu shobozi
l.c: Imyitozo yo gusoma no kwandika amagambo n'interuro birimo ibihekane byizwe.
l.m:
•Igitabo cy’umunyeshuri; •Igitabo cy’umwarimu;
•Izindi mfashanyigisho zifatika n'izidafatika zijyanye n’isomo, umwarimu ashobora kubona aho ishuri riherereye.
l.e: Gukora isuzuma risoza icyumweru n'imyitozo nzamurabusho bozi na nyagurabush obozi yateguwe.

l.t: Gusoma no gusesengura ikiganiro hagati y’abantu babiri
l.o: Gusoma no gusubiza neza ibibazo bijyanye no gusesengura ikiganiro hagati y'abantu babiri.
l.c: Gusoma umwandiko no gusubiza ibibazo byo gusesengura umwandiko.
l.m:
•Imfashanyigisho zifatika n'zidafatika;
•Amashusho yo mu gitabo cy’umwarimu gikubiyemo inkuru zisomerwa abanyeshuri.
l.e: Kubaza ibindi bibazo ku nkuru no kunsanganyamatsiko bifasha abanyeshuri gukomeza gutekereza byagutse.

l.t: Kwandika ikiganiro hagati y’abantu babiri
l.o: Guhanga ikiganiro.
l.c: Guhanga inkuru irimo ibihekane yize.
l.m:
•Imfashanyigisho zifatika n'zidafatika;
•Amashush o yo mu gitabo cy’umwarimu gikubiyem o inkuru zisomerwa abanyeshur i.
l.e: .Guha abanyeshuri umwitozo wo guhanga inkuru.

l.m:
•Imfashanyigisho zifatika n'zidafatika;
•Amashusho yo mu gitabo cy’umwarimu gikubiyemo inkuru zisomerwa abanyeshuri.
l.e: Gukina inkuru basomye cyangwa gukina ikinamico bafashe mu mutwe imbere y'abandi banyeshuri.

l.t: Isuzuma risoza icyumweru n'imyitozo nzamurabush obozi na nyagurabush obozi
l.o:
•Gusoma no kwandika mu mukono amagambo n’interuro zirimo ibihekane byizwe;
•Gufasha abanyeshuri bitewe n'ubushozi bagaragaje.
l.c: Imyitozo yo gusoma no kwandika amagambo n'interuro birimo ibihekane byizwe.
l.e: Gukora isuzuma risoza icyumweru n'imyitozo nzamurabusho bozi na nyagurabusho bozi yateguwe.

l.t: Isuzuma risoza umutwe wa munani Imyitozo nzamurabush obozi na nyagurabush obozi
l.o:
Gusuzuma niba intego z'ibyigwa muri uyu mutwe byaragezweho hashingiwe ku bushobozi bw'ingenzi bugamijwe.

Ibibazo by'isuzuma.

l.e:
.Gukora isuzuma risoza umutwe.
